name: FrogPond
short: Race to unscramble pond words and get a frog home.
description: A lightweight chat word game with 100 built-in nature clues, timed hints, a double-points golden fly and persistent server leaderboards. Solve enough puzzles together to help the frog cross the pond. No API keys or extra dependencies. Stops on reload, disabled-cog state or AcroGame starting in the same channel.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Stores Discord user IDs with per-server points and solved-puzzle counts. Active games keep the starter ID and player scores in memory, cleared on stop, reload or restart. Guess text is neither archived nor deleted. Data deletion cancels affected games and removes the user's stored scores. Already posted Discord game messages are not removed.
install_msg: Frog Pond installed! Run [p]load frogpond, then [p]frog. Type answers directly in chat. Use [p]frog rules for scoring and [p]frog top for the leaderboard.
